# DOCX roundtrip regression fixture

`roundtrip.docx` is the project-authored CAP-012 D01 synthetic Chinese/English roundtrip probe, not a user document. It is copied byte-for-byte from the original `work/d-docx-roundtrip-probe-01/roundtrip.docx` so fresh checkouts can run the accepted real-OOXML readback regression without private work history.
